sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: In October 2014, psychology professor Nancy Siegel heard a story.
sentences.zh: 2014年10月，心理学教授南希·西格尔听到了一个故事。

sentences.en: It was about her specialty, the study of twins.
sentences.zh: 那是关于她的专业领域——双胞胎研究的。

sentences.en: It's December 1988.
sentences.zh: 时间回到1988年12月。

sentences.en: A woman from a remote farming village in Colombia makes a day-long trek to a hospital.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚一个偏远农场村庄的妇女，跋涉了一整天来到一家医院。

sentences.en: She gives birth there to a pair of identical twin boys.
sentences.zh: 她在那里生下了一对同卵双胞胎男孩。

sentences.en: One of the twins needs more advanced medical care that isn't available.
sentences.zh: 其中一个双胞胎需要更先进的医疗护理，但当地没有条件。

sentences.en: One of them was extremely sick.
sentences.zh: 其中一个孩子病得非常重。

sentences.en: Since the mom is still recuperating, a relative takes him to another hospital six hours away in Bogota, the capital.
sentences.zh: 由于母亲还在恢复期，一位亲戚带着孩子去了六小时路程外的首都波哥大的另一家医院。

sentences.en: At the Bogota hospital, another set of identical twin boys has just been born.
sentences.zh: 在波哥大的那家医院，刚好也有一对同卵双胞胎男孩出生。

sentences.en: Their mother is a seamstress who lives in the city.
sentences.zh: 他们的母亲是一位住在城里的裁缝。

sentences.en: The scene was quite chaotic.
sentences.zh: 当时的场面相当混乱。

sentences.en: The hospital staff is tired and overworked.
sentences.zh: 医院的工作人员既疲惫又超负荷工作。

sentences.en: It was approaching Christmas time.
sentences.zh: 那时临近圣诞节。

sentences.en: People were thinking about the holidays.
sentences.zh: 人们都在想着过节的事。

sentences.en: Now, nobody knows exactly what happens next, but something goes wrong.
sentences.zh: 现在，没人确切知道接下来发生了什么，但确实出了差错。

sentences.en: The baby from the countryside is switched
sentences.zh: 来自农村的那个婴儿

sentences.en: with one of the babies born to the mother from the city.
sentences.zh: 被换成了城里母亲所生的婴儿之一。

sentences.en: By the time all the babies are sent home,
sentences.zh: 等到所有婴儿都被送回家时，

sentences.en: one boy from each pair of identical twins is in the wrong family.
sentences.zh: 每对同卵双胞胎中都有一个男孩被送错了家庭。

sentences.en: Each family thinks their twins are fraternal.
sentences.zh: 每个家庭都以为他们的双胞胎是异卵的。

sentences.en: The homes the boys grow up in are in totally different places,
sentences.zh: 男孩们成长的家庭环境完全不同，

sentences.en: 150 miles away from each other and a world apart.
sentences.zh: 相隔150英里，简直是两个世界。

sentences.en: One, the lively capital city of Bogota,
sentences.zh: 一个是繁华的首都波哥大，

sentences.en: and the other in a very remote farming village.
sentences.zh: 另一个是非常偏远的农耕村庄。

sentences.en: 25 years later, when the truth was discovered,
sentences.zh: 25年后，当真相被揭开时，

sentences.en: Nancy says it was also deeply painful.
sentences.zh: 南希说，那也是极其痛苦的。

sentences.en: It was also a tragedy in the sense that two of the twins grew up in a home
sentences.zh: 这更是一场悲剧，因为其中两名双胞胎在同一个家庭长大，

sentences.en: where they were not biologically connected,
sentences.zh: 却在生物学上毫无血缘关系，

sentences.en: and they discovered in a matter of minutes that their identities were totally shattered.
sentences.zh: 他们几分钟内就发现自己的身份彻底崩塌了。

sentences.en: They weren't who they thought they were.
sentences.zh: 他们并非他们所认为的那个人。

sentences.en: They belonged in other families.
sentences.zh: 他们本应属于其他家庭。

sentences.en: Their parents were not their parents.
sentences.zh: 他们的父母并非他们的亲生父母。

sentences.en: In short, everything about their life was basically a lie.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他们生活的一切基本上都是谎言。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we revisit the story we released a couple of years ago
sentences.zh: 本周在《隐藏的大脑》节目中，我们重温几年前发布的故事，

sentences.en: about the Bogota twins.
sentences.zh: 关于波哥大的那对双胞胎。

sentences.en: It was a tragedy, a soap opera, and a science experiment all rolled into one.
sentences.zh: 这既是悲剧，又是肥皂剧，还是科学实验，三者合而为一。

sentences.en: And we'll also find out why twin studies can act as a natural experiment
sentences.zh: 我们还将探讨为什么双胞胎研究可以作为一种自然实验，

sentences.en: to test some of the biggest questions about human nature.
sentences.zh: 来测试关于人性的一些重大问题。

sentences.en: Nancy Siegel is a professor of psychology at California State University, Fullerton.
sentences.zh: 南希·西格尔是加州州立大学富勒顿分校的心理学教授。

sentences.en: She's the director of their Twin Studies Center.
sentences.zh: 她是该校双胞胎研究中心的主任。

sentences.en: She wrote about the Bogota twins in her book,
sentences.zh: 她在自己的书中记录了波哥大双胞胎的故事，

sentences.en: Accidental Brothers, the Story of Twins Exchanged at Birth, and the Power of Nature and Nurture.
sentences.zh: 书名是《意外的兄弟：出生时被交换的双胞胎的故事，以及先天与后天的力量》。

sentences.en: In both the remote farming village and the city, each set of mismatched brothers had very different
sentences.zh: 无论是在偏远的农耕村庄还是在城市里，每对错位的兄弟都有着截然不同的

sentences.en: outlooks and personalities.
sentences.zh: 人生观和性格。

sentences.en: In each family, one brother seemed outgoing, the other reserved.
sentences.zh: 在每个家庭中，一个兄弟似乎外向，另一个则内向。

sentences.en: And in fact, people would kid the twins and the parents and say,
sentences.zh: 事实上，人们会开玩笑地问双胞胎和他们的父母：

sentences.en: are you sure you're twins?
sentences.zh: 你们确定是双胞胎吗？

sentences.en: And how could you have two boys look so different?
sentences.zh: 怎么会有两个长相差异这么大的男孩？

sentences.en: But people, again, are sensitive to fraternal twin differences.
sentences.zh: 但人们对异卵双胞胎之间的差异是很敏感的。

sentences.en: People know that ordinary siblings in a family who have the same genetic relatedness as fraternal twins often look and act very differently.
sentences.zh: 人们知道，家庭中拥有相同遗传相关性的普通兄弟姐妹，长相和行为往往也大不相同。

sentences.en: So it was not such a tremendous surprise.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不算太大的意外。

sentences.en: The other interesting thing, though, is that in Bogota, the mom had been told she was having identical twins.
sentences.zh: 不过，另一个有趣的地方在于，在波哥大，那位母亲被告知她怀的是同卵双胞胎。

sentences.en: And this might have been information gotten from an early scan.
sentences.zh: 这可能是从早期扫描中获得的信息。

sentences.en: It's possible.
sentences.zh: 这很有可能。

sentences.en: But it could be that, you know, sometimes these things can be unreliable.
sentences.zh: 但也有可能，你知道，有时这些检查结果并不可靠。

sentences.en: And so when she had fraternal twin boys, she accepted it and was quite pleased.
sentences.zh: 所以当她生下异卵双胞胎男孩时，她接受了这个事实，并且感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: William and Wilbur, the two brothers who grew up in the farming village,
sentences.zh: 威廉和威尔伯，这对在农耕村庄长大的兄弟，

sentences.en: eventually moved to Bogota and get jobs behind the counter at a butcher shop.
sentences.zh: 后来搬到了波哥大，在一家肉铺柜台后找到了工作。

sentences.en: It's the summer of 2013.
sentences.zh: 那是2013年的夏天。

sentences.en: They're now 25.
sentences.zh: 他们当时25岁。

sentences.en: And it's here where their lives begin to intersect with the brothers in the city,
sentences.zh: 正是在这里，他们的生活开始与城里的那对兄弟产生交集，

sentences.en: Jorge and Carlos,
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫和卡洛斯，

sentences.en: where it starts to become clear
sentences.zh: 事情开始变得明朗，

sentences.en: that someone, somehow,
sentences.zh: 有人在不知不觉中，

sentences.en: has made a terrible mistake.
sentences.zh: 犯下了一个可怕的错误。

sentences.en: A co-worker of Jorge,
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫的一位同事，

sentences.en: again, one of the twins raised in the city,
sentences.zh: 也就是在城里长大的那对双胞胎之一，

sentences.en: runs into William at the butcher shop.
sentences.zh: 在肉铺里偶遇了威廉。

sentences.en: One day, two women
sentences.zh: 有一天，两名女子

sentences.en: went to the butcher shop to buy some meat.
sentences.zh: 去肉铺买肉。

sentences.en: Now, one of those women
sentences.zh: 其中一名女子

sentences.en: was a co-worker of Jorge's,
sentences.zh: 是豪尔赫的同事，

sentences.en: and her first impulse was,
sentences.zh: 她的第一反应是，

sentences.en: what is Jorge doing behind the butcher counter?
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫怎么会在肉铺柜台后面？

sentences.en: Is he moonlighting as a butcher on weekends?
sentences.zh: 他周末在兼职当屠夫吗？

sentences.en: Is
sentences.zh: 他

sentences.en: he short of money?
sentences.zh: 缺钱吗？

sentences.en: And she was really baffled when he didn't greet her.
sentences.zh: 当他没有打招呼时，她感到非常困惑。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the friend that
sentences.zh: 与此同时，和她在一起的朋友

sentences.en: she was with said, don't be silly, that is my boyfriend's cousin.
sentences.zh: 说，别傻了，那是我男朋友的表亲。

sentences.en: So they're going back and
sentences.zh: 于是她们就这个问题

sentences.en: forth, back and forth on this.
sentences.zh: 争论来争论去。

sentences.en: And finally, he said, my name is William.
sentences.zh: 最后，他说，我叫威廉。

sentences.en: I'm her boyfriend's
sentences.zh: 我是她男朋友的

sentences.en: cousin.
sentences.zh: 表亲。

sentences.en: I don't know Jorge.
sentences.zh: 我不认识豪尔赫。

sentences.en: And that was it.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: But when Laura, this friend, went back to see Jorge,
sentences.zh: 但当劳拉，也就是那位朋友，回去找豪尔赫时，

sentences.en: the following week at work.
sentences.zh: 那是接下来的一周，在工作时。

sentences.en: She told him about it.
sentences.zh: 她把这件事告诉了他。

sentences.en: They had a good laugh about it
sentences.zh: 他们对此大笑了一场，

sentences.en: and nothing really happened.
sentences.zh: 并没有发生什么特别的事。

sentences.en: But something about the incident
sentences.zh: 但那次事件中的某些东西

sentences.en: sticks with Laura.
sentences.zh: 一直萦绕在劳拉心头。

sentences.en: She tracks down a photo of William
sentences.zh: 她找出一张威廉的照片，

sentences.en: and brings it to Jorge's desk.
sentences.zh: 带到了豪尔赫的办公桌前。

sentences.en: She tells him to sit down.
sentences.zh: 她让他坐下。

sentences.en: He's about to be shocked.
sentences.zh: 他即将受到冲击。

sentences.en: Jorge stares at the image on Laura's phone.
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫盯着劳拉手机上的照片。

sentences.en: He swears.
sentences.zh: 他咒骂了一声。

sentences.en: That's me, he says.
sentences.zh: 那是他自己，他说。

sentences.en: One thing leads to another
sentences.zh: 事情一件接一件地发生，

sentences.en: and the two biological brothers
sentences.zh: 这对亲生兄弟

sentences.en: meet for the first time
sentences.zh: 第一次见面了，

sentences.en: at a public square in Bogota.
sentences.zh: 在波哥大的一个公共广场上。

sentences.en: The scene is captured on someone's phone.
sentences.zh: 这一幕被某人的手机拍了下来。

sentences.en: A friend, off-screen, sounds shocked.
sentences.zh: 镜头外的一位朋友听起来很震惊。

sentences.en: Jorge and William look exactly the same.
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫和威廉长得一模一样。

sentences.en: Another friend breaks the ice.
sentences.zh: 另一位朋友打破了沉默。

sentences.en: William is whiter, he says.
sentences.zh: 威廉肤色更白一些，他说。

sentences.en: But other than their complexion,
sentences.zh: 但除了肤色之外，

sentences.en: they are like mirror images,
sentences.zh: 他们就像镜子里的影像，

sentences.en: both handsome with delicate features.
sentences.zh: 都长得很帅，五官精致。

sentences.en: Both have an easy laugh.
sentences.zh: 两人都有着爽朗的笑声。

sentences.en: They steal glances at each other and shift from side to side.
sentences.zh: 他们偷瞄着对方，身体左右摇晃。

sentences.en: Oh my God, says their friend.
sentences.zh: 天哪，他们的朋友说。

sentences.en: This can't be true.
sentences.zh: 这不可能是真的。

sentences.en: Jorge says, I can't believe it.
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫说，我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: To an onlooker, this moment would look like nothing.
sentences.zh: 对于旁观者来说，这一刻看起来没什么特别的。

sentences.en: Just young men joking around.
sentences.zh: 只是年轻人在开玩笑。

sentences.en: Its meaning would sink in only later.
sentences.zh: 它的意义直到后来才真正沉淀下来。

sentences.en: But right now, they have so many questions.
sentences.zh: 但此刻，他们心中有太多的疑问。

sentences.en: William and Jorge go to a nearby coffee shop
sentences.zh: 威廉和豪尔赫去了附近的一家咖啡馆，

sentences.en: where they find they have instant chemistry.
sentences.zh: 在那里他们发现彼此一见如故。

sentences.en: They got along well.
sentences.zh: 他们相处得很好。

sentences.en: They understood the world the same way.
sentences.zh: 他们对世界的理解方式如出一辙。

sentences.en: And that was something rare for them
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说是件稀罕事，

sentences.en: because neither one of them shared it
sentences.zh: 因为他们两人都无法与

sentences.en: with their so-called fraternal twin brother.
sentences.zh: 各自所谓的“异卵”双胞胎兄弟产生这种共鸣。

sentences.en: Up next would be the reunion
sentences.zh: 接下来是另一对同卵双胞胎的重逢，

sentences.en: of the other identical twin pair,
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯和威尔伯。

sentences.en: Carlos and Wilbur.
sentences.zh: 这里有一点我之前没提到。

sentences.en: And here's something I've left out of the story.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上威尔伯也在广场上，

sentences.en: Wilbur was also at the square that night
sentences.zh: 在旁边看着。

sentences.en: watching from the sidelines.
sentences.zh: 当时就决定了，

sentences.en: It was decided then and there
sentences.zh: 他应该尽快见到他的同卵双胞胎兄弟卡洛斯。

sentences.en: that he should meet his identical twin, Carlos, as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 三个年轻人打车去寻找卡洛斯。

sentences.en: The three young men get in a cab to go find Carlos.
sentences.zh: 这次重逢对卡洛斯来说很艰难。

sentences.en: The reunion is hard for Carlos.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他本该在农场长大，而不是在城市。

sentences.en: It meant he was supposed to have grown up on a farm, not a city.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他的兄弟并非他的亲兄弟。

sentences.en: It meant his brother was not his real brother.
sentences.zh: 他的姐妹并非他的亲姐妹。

sentences.en: His sister was not his real sister.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲并非他的亲生母亲。

sentences.en: His mother was not his real mother.
sentences.zh: 因为你必须记住，卡洛斯是个城市男孩。

sentences.en: Because you've got to remember that Carlos was a city boy.
sentences.zh: 他深爱着几年前去世的母亲，发现她可能不是自己的亲生母亲，对他来说简直是毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: He loved his mother, who had passed away a few years earlier, and to discover that she might not be his mother was absolutely devastating to him.
sentences.zh: 第一次见到同卵兄弟威尔伯时，卡洛斯竭尽全力想找出他们之间的不同之处。

sentences.en: The first time he saw his identical brother, Wilbur, Carlos went out of his way to try and find differences between them.
sentences.zh: 但他白费力气，因为他们长得一模一样。

sentences.en: But he looked in vain because they looked exactly the same.
sentences.zh: 他们两人都非常、非常在意自己的外表。

sentences.en: Both of them were very, very interested in appearance.
sentences.zh: 他们两人都非常、非常在意自己的外表。

sentences.en: Both of them got their eyebrows waxed, very into fashion.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都去修了眉毛，非常赶时髦。

sentences.en: They both liked similar types of girlfriends.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢的女朋友类型也很相似。

sentences.en: they both call themselves the crybabies because they were very sensitive as children.
sentences.zh: 他们都自称“爱哭鬼”，因为小时候非常敏感。

sentences.en: They were
sentences.zh: 他们

sentences.en: always complaining and always kind of undergoing various medical complaints, whereas Jorge and
sentences.zh: 总是抱怨，也总是患有各种各样的疾病，而豪尔赫和

sentences.en: William had no medical complaints whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 威廉则完全没有任何健康问题。

sentences.en: We gave them long medical histories, and Jorge and
sentences.zh: 我们给了他们长长的病史记录，而豪尔赫和

sentences.en: William just had handed them in blank.
sentences.zh: 威廉交上来的却是一片空白。

sentences.en: But Carlos and Wilbur had long lists of various types of
sentences.zh: 但卡洛斯和威尔伯却列出了长长的一串各种类型的

sentences.en: pains and aches and other ailments.
sentences.zh: 病痛和不适。

sentences.en: Did the brothers stay in touch after the mix-up was
sentences.zh: 在身份错乱被纠正和揭露之后，

sentences.en: corrected and revealed?
sentences.zh: 这对兄弟还有联系吗？

sentences.en: Oh yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，有的。

sentences.en: In fact, they call themselves, well, I call them the band of brothers
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们自称——嗯，我称他们为“兄弟连”，

sentences.en: because they do that.
sentences.zh: 因为他们确实如此。

sentences.en: And they have stayed in touch.
sentences.zh: 他们一直保持着联系。

sentences.en: They make decisions based on four.
sentences.zh: 他们四个人一起做决定。

sentences.en: They
sentences.zh: 他们

sentences.en: have a common email address.
sentences.zh: 共用一个电子邮箱地址。

sentences.en: They really are very close.
sentences.zh: 他们确实非常亲密。

sentences.en: And you know, what's important is that there
sentences.zh: 你知道，重要的是，他们

sentences.en: are two ways they could have handled this.
sentences.zh: 处理这件事的方式有两种。

sentences.en: One would have been complete despair.
sentences.zh: 一种是彻底陷入绝望。

sentences.en: And the other
sentences.zh: 而另一种

sentences.en: is simply accepting and moving on.
sentences.zh: 则是坦然接受并继续生活。

sentences.en: And so they and their family members say, look, we did not lose a
sentences.zh: 所以他们和他们的家人说，看，我们没有失去一个

sentences.en: nephew, we did not lose a brother, we did not lose a son, we're gaining.
sentences.zh: 侄子，没有失去一个兄弟，没有失去一个儿子，我们反而有所收获。

sentences.en: And I think that they should
sentences.zh: 我认为他们应该

sentences.en: be applauded for that kind of an attitude and for carrying it out so successfully.
sentences.zh: 因为这种态度以及如此成功地践行这种态度而受到赞扬。

sentences.en: As a researcher, obviously, you've been fascinated by, you know, how the bonds of
sentences.zh: 作为一名研究人员，显然，你一直对基因联系如何

sentences.en: genetic connection might prompt, you know, similarities.
sentences.zh: 可能引发相似性感到着迷。

sentences.en: But when you went down to Bogota,
sentences.zh: 但当你去波哥大时，

sentences.en: did you also find that the bonds of familial connection, growing up in the same household,

sentences.zh: 当他们长大后，我第一次见到他们时感到非常震惊，

sentences.en: because they looked like the same version of each other,
sentences.zh: 因为他们看起来就像是同一个人的不同版本，

sentences.en: but just one very small and one very big.
sentences.zh: 只是一个非常小，一个非常大。

sentences.en: And then when I went back to see them again in their young adult years,
sentences.zh: 后来当我再次见到他们时，他们已经步入青年时期，

sentences.en: it turned out that the taller twin was seven inches taller than the other one.
sentences.zh: 结果发现较高的那个双胞胎比另一个高出七英寸。

sentences.en: So that was something that had a lasting imprint on these still identical genes.
sentences.zh: 所以，这对仍然拥有相同基因的双胞胎产生了持久的影响。

sentences.en: Differences in the womb led these twins to look very different.
sentences.zh: 子宫内的差异导致这对双胞胎看起来大不相同。

sentences.en: Similarly, other environmental differences can act on two people with the same genes
sentences.zh: 同样，其他环境差异也会作用于拥有相同基因的两个人，

sentences.en: and reshape them dramatically.
sentences.zh: 并戏剧性地重塑他们。

sentences.en: One of the best examples of this might be the Bogota twins that Nancy studied.
sentences.zh: 这方面最好的例子之一可能是南希研究过的波哥大双胞胎。

sentences.en: Consider, for example, one of the brothers who grew up in the wrong home, William.
sentences.zh: 以其中一个在错误家庭中长大的兄弟威廉为例。

sentences.en: He was born to the city mother, but raised on a farm.
sentences.zh: 他由城市里的母亲所生，却在农场长大。

sentences.en: Even as a small child, he was studious and drawn to learning.
sentences.zh: 即使在孩提时代，他就很好学，渴望知识。

sentences.en: But his circumstances put brakes on his natural inclinations.
sentences.zh: 但他的处境限制了他的天赋。

sentences.en: Opportunities for education in his poor farming village, Nancy says, were greatly limited.
sentences.zh: 南希说，在他贫穷的农耕村庄里，受教育的机会非常有限。

sentences.en: They were not available, and so he decided to join the army.
sentences.zh: 这些机会根本不存在，所以他决定参军。

sentences.en: And in the army, once you complete your service, you are entitled to take some sort of officer's training course.
sentences.zh: 在军队里，一旦服役期满，你就有权参加某种军官培训课程。

sentences.en: And that seemed perfect for William.
sentences.zh: 这对威廉来说似乎非常完美。

sentences.en: It would have meant going to school and being paid for by the government.
sentences.zh: 这意味着可以上学，而且费用由政府承担。

sentences.en: But it turned out, unfortunately, that while he was in the service, he had contracted a disease called leishmaniasis.
sentences.zh: 但不幸的是，他在服役期间患上了一种叫利什曼病的疾病。

sentences.en: And while he recovered from it, that put him completely out of the running.
sentences.zh: 虽然他康复了，但这让他彻底失去了机会。

sentences.en: William's dream of getting an education through the army was dashed.
sentences.zh: 威廉通过军队接受教育的梦想破灭了。

sentences.en: And by the time he discovered the truth about his origin, he had resigned himself to not getting a proper education.
sentences.zh: 当他发现自己身世的真相时，他已经放弃了接受正规教育的念头。

sentences.en: He had begun to work at the butcher shop in Bogota.
sentences.zh: 他开始在波哥大的一家肉铺工作。

sentences.en: This is when the co-worker of his identical twin happened to stop by the shop.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，他同卵双胞胎兄弟的同事偶然路过了这家店。

sentences.en: What happened in the years that followed is even more revealing about the power of the environment to reshape our genetic inheritance.
sentences.zh: 随后的几年里发生的事情，更深刻地揭示了环境重塑我们基因遗传的力量。

sentences.en: With William, there were just fewer opportunities he could even pick from.
sentences.zh: 对于威廉来说，他能选择的机会实在太少了。

sentences.en: That was his trouble until he got down to Bogota.
sentences.zh: 在他去波哥大之前，这就是他的困境。

sentences.en: Now, what's happened to William since then, and since he's met his brother Jorge, he is now enrolled in law school in Bogota.
sentences.zh: 现在，威廉自那以后，也就是见到他的兄弟豪尔赫之后，他现在已经在波哥大入读法学院了。

sentences.en: He's in his second year of it now, and with the help of Carlos, actually, who was not related to him genetically or environmentally, Carlos helped him research law schools,
sentences.zh: 他现在读大二，而且在卡洛斯的帮助下——事实上，卡洛斯与他在基因或环境上都没有关系，卡洛斯帮他研究了法学院，

sentences.en: and now that's where he's looking to continue his education.
sentences.zh: 现在他打算在那里继续深造。

sentences.en: He has political aspirations.
sentences.zh: 他有从政的抱负。

sentences.en: He wants to go back to the town that he grew up in and become the mayor of the town.
sentences.zh: 他想回到他长大的那个城镇，成为那里的市长。

sentences.en: Carlos was the other brother who grew up in the wrong home.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯是另一个在错误家庭中长大的兄弟。

sentences.en: He was born to the poor family from a rural area, but was raised in Bogota.
sentences.zh: 他出生在农村的一个贫困家庭，却在波哥大长大。

sentences.en: His life, too, was dramatically reshaped by living in the city.
sentences.zh: 他的生活也因为在城市生活而发生了巨大的重塑。

sentences.en: Carlos is working as a financial analyst, having completed college and several advanced certificates.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯目前担任金融分析师，已经完成了大学学业并获得了多项高级证书。

sentences.en: And he's very much a man about town.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常时髦的城市人。

sentences.en: He loves nice clothes.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢漂亮的衣服。

sentences.en: He loves cultural activities.
sentences.zh: 他热爱文化活动。

sentences.en: And for a long time, he had a lot of trouble with William saying, well, why didn't William do this and why didn't William do that?
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，他一直对威廉感到困惑，心想为什么威廉不这样做，为什么威廉不那样做？

sentences.en: But he really didn't understand that there were no opportunities.
sentences.zh: 但他真的不明白，当时根本没有任何机会。

sentences.en: There just weren't any.
sentences.zh: 确实什么都没有。

sentences.en: For an academic discipline, twin studies have drawn an extraordinary amount of controversy.
sentences.zh: 作为一门学术学科，双胞胎研究引起了极大的争议。

sentences.en: There are debates about its central paradigm, which is that differences between identical twins and fraternal twins are explained by genes.
sentences.zh: 关于其核心范式存在争论，即同卵双胞胎和异卵双胞胎之间的差异是由基因解释的。

sentences.en: But if families and teachers treat identical twins differently than they treat fraternal twins,
sentences.zh: 但如果家庭和老师对待同卵双胞胎的方式与对待异卵双胞胎不同，

sentences.en: could some of the differences between the groups be driven by upbringing, nurture, rather than nature?
sentences.zh: 那么这些群体之间的一些差异是否可能是由后天教养而非先天基因驱动的呢？

sentences.en: Underlying many of these debates is an unease.
sentences.zh: 这些争论的背后是一种不安。

sentences.en: If genes determine our intelligence and personality,
sentences.zh: 如果基因决定了我们的智力和性格，

sentences.en: what does this say about differences we see in society between people?
sentences.zh: 那么这对于我们社会中人与人之间的差异意味着什么？

sentences.en: Although we've seen how it's impossible to separate the effect of genes
sentences.zh: 尽管我们已经看到在任何一个人身上，将基因的影响

sentences.en: from the environment in any person,
sentences.zh: 与环境的影响分离开来是不可能的，

sentences.en: it's tempting to explain differences between people by pointing to their genes.
sentences.zh: 但人们还是倾向于通过指向基因来解释人与人之间的差异。

sentences.en: Why is one person rich and another poor?
sentences.zh: 为什么一个人富有而另一个人贫穷？

sentences.en: Genes.
sentences.zh: 基因。

sentences.en: Why do we see different outcomes in the workplace between a man and a woman?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们在职场中看到男性和女性有不同的结果？

sentences.en: Genes.
sentences.zh: 基因。

sentences.en: If biology explains intelligence, why bother with public education?
sentences.zh: 如果生物学解释了智力，那为什么还要费心搞公共教育呢？

sentences.en: After all, if we are smart, it's because of our genes.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，如果我们聪明，那是因为我们的基因。

sentences.en: If we are dumb, it's because of our genes.
sentences.zh: 如果我们愚笨，那也是因为我们的基因。

sentences.en: I asked Nancy what she made of such arguments.
sentences.zh: 我问南希她对这些论点有何看法。

sentences.en: Well, that's a real misunderstanding of the way that the genes work.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那确实是对基因运作方式的误解。

sentences.en: Because after all, behavior is a function of genes being expressed in an environment.
sentences.zh: 因为归根结底，行为是基因在环境中表达的结果。

sentences.en: And by moderating or fixing the environment in different ways, you can alter gene expression.
sentences.zh: 通过以不同方式调节或改善环境，你可以改变基因的表达。

sentences.en: Now, some behaviors are harder to alter than others, but everybody can improve.
sentences.zh: 当然，有些行为比其他行为更难改变，但每个人都可以进步。

sentences.en: Everybody can develop new skills and get better at that.
sentences.zh: 每个人都可以发展新技能并变得更好。

sentences.en: People can't all be the same.
sentences.zh: 人不可能都一样。

sentences.en: We're not all the same.
sentences.zh: 我们并非完全相同。

sentences.en: We're not all one big identical twin.
sentences.zh: 我们不是同一个巨大的同卵双胞胎。

sentences.en: But everybody probably has talents, interests, all kinds of abilities that are undiscovered
sentences.zh: 但每个人可能都有天赋、兴趣和各种未被发现的能力，

sentences.en: because they've never had a chance to express them.
sentences.zh: 因为他们从未有机会去表达它们。

sentences.en: Just as people are wrong in thinking that genes determine everything about our lives,
sentences.zh: 正如人们认为基因决定了我们生活的一切是错误的，

sentences.en: those who say the environment explains everything are also missing something crucial.
sentences.zh: 那些认为环境解释了一切的人也忽略了一些至关重要的东西。

sentences.en: The environments we find ourselves in are themselves shaped by the proclivities and propensities
sentences.zh: 我们所处的环境本身就是由我们基因中编码的

sentences.en: that are encoded in our genes.
sentences.zh: 倾向和习性所塑造的。

sentences.en: Especially when it comes to human behavior, nature and nurture really are inextricably intertwined.
sentences.zh: 特别是在人类行为方面，先天和后天确实是密不可分的。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: We all pick certain items in our environment that are compatible with who we are.
sentences.zh: 我们都会在环境中选择与我们自身相契合的事物。

sentences.en: And so while one person might be drawn to dance lessons, one person to music, one person
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然一个人可能被舞蹈课吸引，另一个人被音乐吸引，另一个人

sentences.en: to art, these are the things that mean that we fashion our environment.
sentences.zh: 被艺术吸引，这些正是意味着我们塑造了我们的环境。

sentences.en: So environments, in a sense, are genetically influenced.
sentences.zh: 因此，从某种意义上说，环境是受基因影响的。

sentences.en: And then within those environments, certain genetic propensities might be expressed.
sentences.zh: 而在这些环境中，某些基因倾向可能会得到表达。

sentences.en: So in some ways, what I'm hearing you say, Nancy, is that our genes indeed are very powerful
sentences.zh: 所以南希，我听到你说的在某种程度上是，我们的基因确实在塑造我们方面非常强大，

sentences.en: in shaping us, but they're not necessarily deterministic.
sentences.zh: 但它们并不一定是决定性的。

sentences.en: It's one thing to say that
sentences.zh: 说智力是可遗传的一回事，但当你断言，你知道，你62.35%的智力来自你的

sentences.en: intelligence is heritable, but when you say, you know, 62.35% of your intelligence came from your
sentences.zh: 基因时，我们可能犯了虚假精确的错误。

sentences.en: genes, we might be guilty of false precision.
sentences.zh: 我同意这一点。

sentences.en: I agree with that.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为人们对这项研究产生的一些

sentences.en: And I think that some of the
sentences.zh: 恐惧在于，一旦你拥有了你的基因，你就被它们困住了。

sentences.en: fears people have had from this research is that once you've got your genes, you're stuck with them.
sentences.zh: 而这并不完全正确。

sentences.en: And that's not really true.
sentences.zh: 是我们自己决定要做什么，付出多少努力，

sentences.en: We are the ones who make decisions about what we will do, how hard
sentences.zh: 以及如何去实现我们的目标。

sentences.en: we will work, how we will go about getting our goals.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，基因只是倾向。

sentences.en: After all, genes are just propensities.
sentences.zh: 它们不是决定性的。

sentences.en: They're not deterministic.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们都可以为我们所取得的成就感到无比自豪和快乐。

sentences.en: I think that we can all take tremendous pride and happiness
sentences.zh: 我了解到你自己也有一个双胞胎。

sentences.en: in those things that we accomplish.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I understand that you yourself have a twin.
sentences.zh: 我有一个异卵双胞胎妹妹，安妮。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 我是早出生七分钟的姐姐，

sentences.en: I have a fraternal twin sister, Anne.
sentences.zh: 但我也是矮四英寸的那个双胞胎。

sentences.en: I'm the older twin by seven minutes,
sentences.zh: 我们在人生观、外貌、才华上都非常不同，但我们有很深的家庭忠诚感，我想可能还有

sentences.en: but I'm also the shorter twin by four inches.
sentences.zh: 很多其他方面。

sentences.en: And we are very different in our outlooks,
sentences.zh: 很多其他方面。

sentences.en: in our appearance, in our talents, but we have a lot of family loyalty, and I think there's probably
sentences.zh: 很多其他方面。

sentences.en: no one I love as much in my family as my sister.
sentences.zh: 在我家里，我最爱的人就是我的姐姐。

sentences.en: Nancy Siegel is professor of psychology at
sentences.zh: 南希·西格尔是加州大学富勒顿分校的心理学教授，

sentences.en: California State University Fullerton and the director of their Twin Studies Center.
sentences.zh: 同时也是该校双胞胎研究中心的主任。

sentences.en: She is
sentences.zh: 她是

sentences.en: the author of Accidental Brothers, The Story of Twins Exchanged at Birth, and the Power of Nature
sentences.zh: 《意外的兄弟：出生时被交换的双胞胎的故事，以及先天与后天的力量》一书的作者。

sentences.en: and Nurture.
sentences.zh: （书名续）

sentences.zh: 南希，感谢你今天参加《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.zh: 他非常热衷于为年轻记者提供机会。

sentences.zh: 我经常在食堂看到路易斯，

sentences.en: helping interns craft cover letters

sentences.en: and prepare for job interviews.
sentences.zh: 并为面试做准备。

sentences.zh: 路易斯就像一个活生生的榜样，

sentences.en: of how we can all help change the trajectory
sentences.zh: 提醒我们每个人都可以如何帮助改变

sentences.en: of other people's lives.
sentences.zh: 他人的人生轨迹。

sentences.zh: 谢谢你，路易斯。
